description: Send a transactional email. You describe what happened; Sendable writes the copy and sends it. Data values are inserted verbatim and never rewritten — format them exactly as they should read (e.g. "$99.00", not 99). Use this for anything a user could reasonably want to unsubscribe from.

data.description: Flat key/value pairs. Strings, numbers, booleans only — never nested objects or arrays.

event.description: What happened, snake_case past tense: order_shipped, trial_ending, invite_accepted. Free-form — there is no list to register against.

to.description: Email address, or a user id previously passed to identify.

name: send
